entities.name: Alexi
entities.description: A zephyr mage of Jamuraa whom the Keldons curse in battle.

entities.name: Latulla
entities.description: A Keldon overseer who wages brutal war on Jamuraa.

entities.name: Greel
entities.description: A mind raker who plays with his victims and unsettles even the Keldons.

entities.name: Jolrael
entities.description: The empress of beasts, who tends the land and the beasts of Jamuraa.

entities.name: Haddad
entities.description: A Kipamu soldier who suffers at Greel's hands.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who seeks to rediscover secrets.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: A being who made angels and was called a goddess.

entities.name: Keldons
entities.description: The warlike people of Keld who ravage Jamuraa.

entities.name: Kipamu League
entities.description: A Jamuraan people and league opposing the Keldons.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: The continent ravaged by war between Keld and its enemies.

entities.name: Vintara Forest
entities.description: A forest of Jamuraa that welcomes its enemies with a crushing embrace.

events.summary: Greel grins as Haddad grunts in pain while Greel drains his strength.
events.quote: With each grunt of pain from Haddad, Greel's grin widened.

events.summary: Latulla gives Greel a gift, whom he intends to play with.
events.quote: You're Latulla's gift to me, and I always play with my presents.

events.summary: Keldons smash all unfamiliar statues after a chimeric idol attacks them.
events.quote: After a chimeric idol attacked them, the Keldons smashed all unfamiliar statues.

events.summary: Keldons took several trenching steeds as trophies of war.
events.quote: The Keldons took several of the steeds as trophies of war.

relations.quote: They no longer care about their own suffering. Show them something worse.
The sword or the lash. Choose.
